purpose: Reconstruct the old Dark Ages starter peasant from references; do not free-generate the production sprite.

forbidden: text-only prompt generation as production source
front/back cardinal substitution for diagonal facings
simple mirroring accepted as an independent facing
class-specific martial-artist markers in the starter sprite

base_character.rule: base movement geometry and foot anchor must remain unchanged by later class/equipment layers

reconstruction_steps: collect original/reference screenshots at native or highest available resolution
identify candidate starter/low-level silhouettes without assuming job from costume
measure head height, shoulder width, torso length, leg length, overall occupied bbox and foot baseline
normalize one neutral BODY_BASE pose into a 24x32 cell without resampling blur
construct NW/NE/SW/SE independently from reference evidence; do not approve mirror-only facings
build IDLE first and pass direction/silhouette gate
derive WALK_1..4 while keeping anchor [12,30] and a connected body silhouette
compare at 1.5x runtime scale against P0/P1 screenshots

must_pass: reads as old Dark Ages before generic retro MMORPG
reads as starter peasant/pre-class rather than martial artist or another class
small adult proportion; not modern chibi
feet share a stable baseline and common anchor
no anti-aliased blur at native size
automatic_reject: invented logo/text/reference board used as source
production PNG created directly from a broad generative prompt
